description: Quarterly KPI history calculated from SEC XBRL filings, newest first, in USD: revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, operating_cash_flow, capex, free_cash_flow, rd_expense, gross_margin, operating_margin, net_margin (margins in percent, EPS in USD per share). Only SEC filers have it; for other companies use get_quarter. limit is the number of quarters (1-16, default 16).

metric.description: One metric, or omit for all

ticker.description: Ticker or company name, such as NVDA, Nvidia, BCS or Barclays

name: get_kpis
title: Get KPI history
